briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and DeepSeek-R2 accelerate AGI timeline as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this week, pushing benchmark scores into new territory. Global funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows in both US and EU. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in multi-agent security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro both launched this month. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant while xAI's Grok-3 and DeepSeek-R2 challenge Western dominance. New agentic capabilities raise alignment concerns.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC 2nm shipments; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters. Saudi Arabia commits $4B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first system to achieve 95% on ARC-AGI-2 trigger coordinated international compute controls?
